newsitem.title: USA: Hancock declines comment on reported unit sale.
newsitem.headline: Hancock declines comment on reported unit sale.

text.p: John Hancock Life Insurance Co declined comment on a published report that it was negotiating to sell its traditional health insurance to WellPoint Health Networks Inc.
The Boston Globe, citing people familiar with the talks, said Hancock was near a deal with Wellpoint, but the sources said the deal could still collapse.

The newspaper said Hancock was a small player in the market and has been hinting for a long time it would bail out. It has a contract to provide coverage for about 67,000 Massachusetts state employees, which represents a substantial piece of its business.
